title: Context compiler — bounded, ranked turn context
description:
Create chatbot/memory/context_compiler.py — the core differentiator in this phase. This module assembles the final context payload for each chat turn by combining: the working-memory buffer (recent turns), episodic retrieval results (ranked, filtered), and any persona/identity context stubs. It must respect a token/character budget, rank relevance across sources, and produce a deterministic, reproducible assembly. Do not use naive concatenation; implement a tiered merge with deduplication and budget-aware truncation.

Before editing, inspect:
- AGENTS.md
- docs/plans_tasks.md
- chatbot/memory/working_memory.py (task d.1)
- chatbot/memory/episodic.py (task d.2)
- chatbot/memory/retrieval.py (task d.3)
- Any existing VectorStore interface or base models from prior phases
- Any existing chatbot/memory/__init__.py

Do not infer APIs, constructor signatures, function names, module locations, or service topology from the task description alone. Inspect the referenced documents and existing implementation files first, then implement against the actual repository.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY chatbot/memory/context_compiler.py and chatbot/memory/__init__.py (if exports are needed). Do NOT modify any other file under any circumstance.
acceptance_criteria: chatbot/memory/context_compiler.py exists with a compile_context function
Context assembly pulls from working memory, episodic retrieval, and persona stubs
Token/character budget is enforced with tiered merge and deduplication
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: use model-based or non-deterministic context assembly
